verdict.rationale: Salv documents resolving alerts: an API endpoint updates alert status, and good-listing remembers matches the team has already cleared. Clearance rules auto-close alerts while keeping every auto-closed alert on the record as an audit trail. Reopening or overriding a decision is not explicitly documented, and the audit trail is only described for auto-closed alerts, not manual analyst resolutions. Missing for 10: explicit reopen/override of a closed alert decision, an audit record for manual analyst resolutions and overrides, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can resolve a false positive and reopen or override the decision with an audit record

citations.quote: Good-listing remembers matches your team has already cleared, keyed on identifiers you choose.
every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.
work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
